method: Independent agent grading, hidden condition labels and shuffled answer order; source-verified whole assertions, including code validity. No post-unmask grade changes.
rubric_notes: Applied every assertion conjunctively with no half credit; a correct conceptual flow does not rescue invented API syntax in the code-based assertion implementing it. Java source confirms execute() -> SimpleSaveResult<E>, execute(View.class) -> SimpleSaveResult.View<E,V>, and table-instance/expression-based createQuery syntax (JSqlClient.java:59-64; SimpleEntitySaveCommand.java:401-419; SimpleSaveResult.java:17-139).

INSERT_IF_ABSENT rejected-root behavior was checked beyond happy-path documentation: Saver.finishSave (Saver.java:265-278) materializes accepted roots only, with a separate exception for association targets; SimpleEntitySaveCommandImpl.execute converts the result to a requested view rather than looking up a conflicting root. A view request therefore does not establish the existing-row contract.

Task/rubric mismatch: inheritance assertion 1 additionally requires distinguishing MappedSuperclass reuse, which the task does not explicitly request. All four answers supply valid entity inheritance but omit that distinction; the original criterion was retained and failed. Public inheritance/mapping.mdx:124-126 also confirms the untagged root with derived types is abstract, so the shown exhaustive two-branch DTO is valid.

Task/rubric mismatch: ShelfPatch assertion 3 additionally requires discussing associated save mode/dissociation, although the task asks for a DTO declaration and a JSON round-trip assertion. All four declarations handle presence correctly, but all omit that additional caveat, so assertion 3 fails. Exactly one DTO is interpreted as one top-level ShelfPatch declaration; its allow-listed nested bins ID shape is explicitly permitted by assertion 4.

Task/rubric mismatch: create-if-absent assertion 3 explicitly demands the technical self-assignment/update-trigger caveat, beyond the task's direct no-update/service-flow question. Only answer-012 states that side-effect warning; the other three fail this assertion while preserving no-update intent.

Task/rubric mismatch: the cache task requests the current supported setup but does not explicitly ask to discuss BOTH. Assertion 1 nevertheless requires rejecting both deprecated transaction modes. None of the four answers supplies that complete explanation; TriggerType.java marks both TRANSACTION_ONLY and BOTH deprecated.

The insert-select rubric additionally requires explaining skipped-row exclusion and avoiding universal native-execution guarantees. Merely naming a variable insertedIds was not treated as that explanation in answer-004/015. Answer-016's unconditional no-application-loading claim fails the execution qualification; public insert-from-select.mdx:459-470 documents dialect/shape fallback materialization. Correct API calls and return-order statements were scored independently.

Equivalent semantics were accepted without mandatory literal API wording: answer-011 explicitly requires intentional type-change enablement and exact matching, satisfying assertion 4 despite not spelling setTypeChangeAllowed. Conversely, omission of an entire requested caveat was not treated as equivalent wording.

Public Quarkus verification used project/jimmer-quarkus/README.md (1.0.1 dependency coordinates and readiness sections) and JimmerDataSourceRuntimeConfig.java:145-155 (constraintViolationTranslatable=false; sqlStateExceptionTranslator=true). Kotlin revision syntax and root-only semantics match public docs/mutation/save-command/version-mode.mdx:45-59,105-108 and KSaveCommandPartialDsl.kt.

evidence.detail: Calls TRANSACTION_ONLY deprecated but omits BOTH and its deprecation. Otherwise supplies real importer-inclusive CDC to BinLog, retry without checkpoint on invalidation failure, cache gating and two-instance rollout tests.

Does not identify either transaction mode as deprecated or reject BOTH on that basis. Correct all-writer CDC-to-BinLog flow, successful-invalidation-before-ack ordering, retry, readiness gating and cross-instance rollout checks.

Real all-writer CDC including importer, no ack on Redis failure, retries, readiness bypass and multi-instance/replay checks are present. Missing the required deprecation/rejection of both TRANSACTION_ONLY and BOTH.

Rejects TRANSACTION_ONLY without explaining both transaction modes are deprecated and omits BOTH. Correct BinLog delivery for all writers, checkpoint-after-invalidation discipline and gated multi-instance rollout/recovery tests.

Correct rejected-root/View explanation and conceptual acceptance-then-SKU-lookup flow, but SaveResult<Item> is not the Java result API: execute() returns SimpleSaveResult<Item>, so the shown acceptance flow does not compile. Omits technical self-assignment/update-trigger caveat. Correct separate-statement isolation/deletion caveat.

Correct rejection semantics, no-update/self-assignment side-effect warning and concurrency caveat. Rejected lookup code is invented Jimmer Java syntax: createQuery(ItemTable.class), where(ItemTable::sku, eq(...)) and select(ItemTable::id); JSqlClient takes a table instance and expression-based predicates/selections.

Correct conceptual rejected-root contract and separate-statement concurrency caveat. Broken result declaration: execute(ItemView.class) returns SimpleSaveResult.View<Item, ItemView>, not SaveResult<Item>; getModifiedView belongs to that view-result subtype. Omits self-assignment/update-trigger caveat.

Correct conceptual acceptance/lookup and isolation caveat, but nonexistent SaveResult<Item> makes the Java flow uncompilable; execute() returns SimpleSaveResult<Item>. Missing technical self-assignment/update-trigger warning. The 'conflict row must now exist' comment is too strong, though the later concurrent-deletion caveat qualifies it.

Valid Kotlin ASSIGNMENT plus UPSERT/setUpdateWhere(newNonNull(version) gt table.version); checks isAccepted for ordinary rejection and states root-only scope. Matches public version-mode.mdx and KSaveCommandPartialDsl.

Correct Kotlin external-version assignment and newer-only update predicate while preserving insertion; handles isAccepted=false normally and explicitly excludes associated children from version-mode propagation.
Uses verified Kotlin ASSIGNMENT/newNonNull/setUpdateWhere APIs with UPSERT, ordinary isAccepted rejection and root-only version policy.
Correct Kotlin external-version ASSIGNMENT, UPSERT newer-only update predicate, isAccepted rejection handling and explicit non-propagation to child objects.
Correct owning Bin.warehouse @OnDissociate(DELETE), unannotated inverse bins, and explicit child deletion versus database parent-delete cascading; RESTRICT need not change.
Places DELETE on Bin.warehouse only and correctly separates ORM removal of children from FK behavior when deleting the parent.
Correct owning to-one annotation and clean inverse collection; clearly distinguishes ORM dissociation deletes from database parent-delete actions and retains RESTRICT for replacement.
Correct @OnDissociate(DELETE) placement on Bin.warehouse only, explicit ORM child deletion and separate database ON DELETE CASCADE semantics without requiring an FK change.

Valid single dynamic ShelfPatch declaration with id, nullable note and bins? { id }; loaded-null/loaded-empty versus omission assertion is correct. Missing required explanation that collection clearing depends on associated save mode/dissociation policy.

Correct dynamic optional note/bins shape, allow-listed single DTO and loaded-state omission/null/empty assertion. Does not state the associated save-mode/dissociation requirement for actually clearing bins.

Valid dynamic ShelfPatch with nullable note and optional bins association IDs, plus explicit toEntity loaded-state assertions. Collection clear semantics lack the required save-mode/dissociation-policy caveat.

Single allow-listed dynamic DTO correctly preserves omitted note/bins versus explicit null/empty through toEntity. Missing required association save-mode/dissociation explanation for collection clearing.

Correct unified 1.0.1 JitPack runtime/KSP coordinates, Kotlin and model index-dependency configuration, exactly-one CacheReadiness contract, bypass-with-invalidation semantics, tracker/CDC distinction and false/true translator defaults. Verified against public Quarkus README and runtime config.

Supplies matching fork coordinates/JitPack, Kotlin/Jandex setup, exactly one readiness provider with stable nonblank namespace, read/fill bypass while invalidations continue, local-tracker versus CDC distinction and correct Quarkus translator defaults.

Correct 1.0.1 same-family dependencies and JitPack, Kotlin/Jandex visibility, fully specified CacheReadiness CDI contract and invalidation behavior, tracker versus CDC distinction, and false/true translation defaults.

Correct fork coordinates/repository, Kotlin/index-dependency configuration, exactly-one CacheReadiness with stable nonblank namespace and bypass/invalidation contract, local Redis readiness distinction and verified Quarkus false/true translator defaults.

Valid SINGLE_TABLE/discriminator/entity snippets, nullable branch columns and #types/#exhaustive. Missing the required distinction from MappedSuperclass reuse. Derived read-only discriminator and explicitly enabled exact subtype transition satisfy the transition criterion.

Correct inheritance annotations, physical nullability and exhaustive DTO branches, but no MappedSuperclass/reuse distinction. Explains derived read-only discriminator, disabled-by-default transitions and intentional enablement with exact matching; semantic enablement is accepted without requiring the literal setter name.

Valid entity hierarchy and exhaustive DTO syntax, explicit database-nullability explanation and read-only discriminator with opt-in exact type transition. Missing required distinction between entity inheritance and MappedSuperclass reuse.

Correct mapping syntax, nullable subtype columns, exhaustive branch DTO and explicitly enabled exact subtype transitions with derived discriminator. Does not distinguish MappedSuperclass reuse as required by assertion 1.

Valid typed base-table source, createInsert mappings, ID conflict key and returning syntax. States unordered results, single-physical-table target and dialect qualification, but never explains that skipped conflicts are excluded from returning.

Correct typed source, separate archive target, column mappings, ID conflict handling and returning API. Dialect-qualified execution and joined-target exclusion are correct; only unspecified order is explained, not exclusion of skipped conflicts from returned IDs.

Correct typed insert source/mappings/conflict API, inserted-only returning and unordered IDs. Rejects joined targets, but unconditionally claims INSERT ... SELECT avoids application entity loading; public insert-from-select.mdx documents materialization/save-pipeline fallback for unsupported dialects or shapes.
Correct typed base source, target mappings and ID conflict key; explicitly returns inserted-only unordered IDs, rejects joined targets and acknowledges dialect-dependent source materialization.
